Analyze this TypeScript/JavaScript file and extract symbols.

1. DEFINITIONS: All callable symbols defined in this file (exported AND non-exported), so same-file calls resolve. Component-scope helper arrow functions count too.
   - Named exports: use exported name (e.g., "export const Foo" → "Foo")
   - Default exports: use the NAME, NOT the word "default"
     - "export default MyComponent" → "MyComponent"
     - "export { X } from './foo'         → {"name":"X", "source":"./foo", "alias":null}
     - "export * as ns from './foo'       → {"name":"*", "source":"./foo", "alias":"ns"}
     - "export { default } from './foo'   → {"name":"default", "source":"./foo", "alias":null}
     - "export { X as Y } from './foo'    → {"name":"X", "source":"./foo", "alias":"Y"}
     - "export * from './foo'             → {"name":"*", "source":"./foo", "alias":null}
   - Exported object literals whose properties are functions/arrows the same as classes. Example: export const api = { workers() {} } → {"name":"api", "kind":"class", "parent": null, "bases": ["BaseService"], "params": [], "returns": null, "line": 1}
   - Exported named functions/arrows defined at module OR component scope: use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
     - "export { X } from './foo'         → {"name":"X", "source":"./foo", "alias":null}
   2. REFERENCES: All IMPORTS AND RE-EXPORTS from other PROJECT files (internal dependencies). Include: named imports, default imports, namespace imports. INCLUDE re-export statements (barrel files / index files): export { X } from './foo'         → {"name":"X", "source":"./foo", "alias":null}
     - "export * as ns from './foo'       → {"name":"*", "source":"./foo", "alias":"ns"}
   3. CALLS: For each function/method/component DEFINED in this file, list the calls it makes.
      For each call, extract:
        - "caller": FQN within this file. Format: Class method: "ClassName.methodName". Constructor: emit as kind="method" with name="constructor".
          Method chain — emit ONE row PER `()` in chain: `obj.X().Y().Z(). …` (use definitions instead).
        - "callee_text": Last segment of the call expression. e.g. "foo", "save", "Bar".
          Receiver type hint — infer receiver types for this/super calls.
          Use bare class name if method, else null.
          For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
        - "receiver": The receiver string EXACTLY as it would be written before the call.
          If this is a method, use bare class name if method, else null.
          For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
        - "receiver_type_hint": Bare class name of the receiver.
          Use bare class name if method, else null.
          For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
        - "receiver_file_hint": Best guess of where the callee is defined. ONE of: absolute path  ("/path/to/file" or "external").
          Use absolute path, or null when not known.
          For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
        - "line": Line number, 1-indexed.

   RECURSE — emit ONE row per `()` invocation. Specifically: Nested args:    outer(inner(). … (use definitions instead).
     - "caller": FQN within this file. Format: Class method: "ClassName.methodName". Constructor: emit as kind="method" with name="constructor".
       Method chain — emit ONE row PER `()` in chain: `obj.X().Y().Z(). …` (use definitions instead).
     - "callee_text": Last segment of the call expression. e.g. "foo", "save", "Bar".
       Receiver type hint — infer receiver types for this/super calls.
         Use bare class name if method, else null.
         For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
       - "receiver": The receiver string EXACTLY as it would be written before the call.
         If this is a method, use bare class name if method, else null.
         For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
       - "receiver_file_hint": Best guess of where the callee is defined. ONE of: absolute path  ("/path/to/file" or "external").
         Use absolute path, or null when not known.
         For nested classes, use INNERMOST class only ("InnerClass.method") — matches definitions_rich.parent rule in CALLS and DEFINITIONS_RICH.
       - "line": Line number, 1-indexed.
